comparison.objective: Depanel a circuit board over a registered break edge and place the freed board in an ESD tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual brace-and-bend fracture with edge registration and post-break handling, rather than load-shared agitation and aperture-based separation.
comparison.success_condition: A directionally valid break at the edge, board correctly trayed, scrap supported, hands clear and both parts stable for 1 s. Candidate forbids loss/damage and requires mass recovery plus washer retention. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Although both coordinate two hands and manage multiple resulting bodies, controlled fracture and tray transfer are materially different from nondestructive physical sieving.
